title: Joining claims and parties
summary: Joinder determines which claims and persons can be included in one action. Different devices govern multiple claims, counterclaims, crossclaims, additional defendants, required parties, interpleader, and intervention.
notes: Permission to combine matters does not make all jurisdictional requirements disappear. Nor does joinder mean all issues must be tried together.

sections.Meaning: Joinder determines which claims and persons can be included in one action. Different devices govern multiple claims, counterclaims, crossclaims, additional defendants, required parties, interpleader, and intervention.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify who is asserting the claim against whom, the relevant rule, the required factual relationship, and whether joinder is optional or required. Then separately establish subject-matter jurisdiction, personal jurisdiction, service, and venue as applicable.
